description: Create a Square hosted Payment Link to fund an authenticated workspace. Requires a workspace Bearer key or OAuth connection; unauthenticated checkout is unavailable. Never send PAN/CVV. Credit packs minimum 100 cents; purpose=mailing minimum 1 cent. Does not send mail. Key environment does not select Square sandbox.

amountCents.description: USD cents to add. Credit packs minimum 100 ($1.00). purpose=mailing may be 1¢ after a coupon.

returnPath.description: Optional site-relative redirect after Square checkout.

name: create_credit_checkout

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.

title: Create Credit Checkout
